rules.label: Rule 1R.
rules.name: Dominant i.
rules.note: No formula in this tile; the rule is set out as a three-column table (Preceding Prefixes / Following Prefix or Stem-Initial Vowel / Resulting Contraction). The formula is printed at the top of the next page (tile p2-b1). Section heading above the rule: 'Vowels: Restricted Rules'.

p1-b2.notes: The first five other_forms are from the running text of Rule 1R ('a final i or ii ... the initial u ... contract to i or ii'). The rest is the table, read block by block. Row 1: rii- | -uks- | riiks-. Block 2 (bracketed): ti-, ii-, ri- | u . . .]STEM (STEM is a small-capital subscript) | tii-, ii-, rii-. Block 3 (bracketed): -i-, -ir-, acir- | -uur- | -iir-, -iir-, -aciir-. In block 3 'acir-' is printed with no leading hyphen although its contraction is printed '-aciir-' with one.

rules.label: Rule 4R.
rules.name: Stem-final Vocalic Reduplication.
rules.formal: Vᵢ(Vᵢ) → Vᵢ(Vᵢ)ʔVᵢ / C _ C + Ø (+ NON-SUB)
rules.note: Each i is a subscript on the V; ʔ is the raised glottal-stop hook; NON-SUB is in small capitals. V and C are roman capitals.

p3-b1.notes: After the Rule 4R examples comes the section heading 'Vowels: Unrestricted Rules' and roman text ('Two or more contiguous vowels ... contract, except when either of two conditions occurs: (1) the second of two vowels is long, or (2) two vowels are in word-final position or preceding a final consonant.'); no Skiri forms there.

rules.note: Unnumbered general statement of vowel contraction (section 'Vowels: Unrestricted Rules'), after 'Vowel contraction takes place when there is a sequence of a short or long vowel followed by a short vowel before one or two consonants. Thus,'. Followed by '(where Vᵢ represents a vowel that is identical to another so-marked vowel in a rule and VᵢVᵢ represents a long vowel).' The i's are subscripts.

rules.name: Same-vowel Contractions.
rules.note: The i's are subscripts. No examples are printed for this rule.

rules.label: Rule 6.
rules.name: Contractions of Any Vowel + u: u-Domination.
rules.formal: [ V, VᵢVᵢ + u | u(u) + V ] → uu / _ C(C)V
rules.note: The left side is two lines inside one pair of square brackets: top line 'V, VᵢVᵢ + u', bottom line 'u(u) + V' (shown here separated by |). u, u(u) and uu are italic; V and C roman.

other_forms: (in the heading of Rule 6: 'Any Vowel + u')

rules.label: Rule 7.
rules.name: Contractions of i and a.
rules.formal: [ i(i) + a | a(a) + i ] → ii / _ C(C)V
rules.note: The left side is two lines inside one pair of square brackets: top line 'i(i) + a', bottom line 'a(a) + i' (shown here separated by |). Lower-case letters italic; C(C)V roman.
